prompt: Make a realistic, cinematic "haunted house" animation, entirely from scratch, in Blender. An old crooked wooden house stands on a small hill at night under a full moon, surrounded by a broken fence, dead trees and a pumpkin patch. Over the animation the house wakes up: the jack-o'-lanterns light up one by one, fog rolls across the ground, bats burst out of the chimney, ghostly shapes drift past the windows, and the front door slowly creaks open with an eerie glow inside. Then everything fades back to a quiet, misty night.
